dwelling_habits.dwelling: Seagrass beds and coral reefs; sleeps in a mucus cocoon by night.
dwelling_habits.food: Algae scraped from rock and dead coral.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Beak bites leave pale scrapes; sand in their waste helps build beaches.
dwelling_habits.mating: Complex sex change: some females become bright terminal-phase males.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Daytime grazing groups; night solo sleepers in slimy sleeping bags.
